metadata.archetype_justification: The application has database connections (MySQL/PDO), CRUD operations on business entities (orders, inventory, payments, returns, users), user-specific data (customer_id, session-based auth), and write endpoints alongside read endpoints. Classified as stateful-crud.

top_gaps.title: Monolith vs Microservices
top_gaps.gap: Tightly-coupled single-file monolith with all business logic in one PHP file
top_gaps.impact: Blocks independent scaling, deployment, and team autonomy

top_gaps.title: CI/CD Automation
top_gaps.gap: No CI/CD pipeline exists — deployments are manual via deploy.sh
top_gaps.impact: Prevents rapid iteration, quality gates, and safe deployments

top_gaps.title: Secrets Management
top_gaps.gap: Hardcoded fallback credential in source code (ecommerce_pass)
top_gaps.impact: Security vulnerability — credential exposed in version control

top_gaps.title: Async Messaging and Streaming
top_gaps.gap: No messaging or async patterns; all inter-domain communication synchronous
top_gaps.impact: Tight coupling between domains, cascading failure risk

top_gaps.title: Async vs Sync Communication
top_gaps.gap: All communication is synchronous HTTP with no async patterns
top_gaps.impact: Tight coupling, timeout amplification across domains

findings.title: No Async Messaging Infrastructure
findings.description: No messaging or streaming infrastructure exists. All cross-domain communication within the monolith is synchronous function calls. No SQS, SNS, EventBridge, Kafka, or any message queue.
findings.gap: No messaging where state changes cross domain boundaries — tight synchronous coupling between domains that should be decoupled.
findings.recommendation: Introduce EventBridge or SQS for cross-domain event propagation as part of decomposition. Order status changes should emit events consumed by inventory, payment, and notification domains.

findings.title: No CI/CD Pipeline
findings.description: No CI/CD pipeline exists. No GitHub Actions, Jenkinsfile, buildspec.yml, or any pipeline definition found. Only deployment mechanism is manual deploy.sh script.
findings.gap: All deployments are manual. No automated build, test, or deploy stages. No quality gates, no automated rollback.
findings.recommendation: Implement a CI/CD pipeline (GitHub Actions or CodePipeline) with stages: lint, build Docker image, push to ECR, deploy to App Runner.

findings.title: Partial IaC Coverage
findings.description: CloudFormation covers compute, database, networking, security, and ECR. However, no operational resources (alarms, backup plans, Route 53 health checks) are defined.
findings.gap: Estimated 60-70% IaC coverage. Primary resources covered but all operational/monitoring infrastructure is absent from IaC.
findings.recommendation: Add CloudWatch alarms, SNS notification topics, and AWS Backup plans to CloudFormation template.

findings.title: No Workflow Orchestration
findings.description: Multi-step fulfillment workflow (validate → assign warehouse → pick → pack → QC → ship → deliver) is entirely hardcoded in application logic.
findings.gap: Multi-step fulfillment workflow is hardcoded with no dedicated orchestrator, no error handling, no retry logic for workflow steps.
findings.recommendation: Adopt AWS Step Functions for the order fulfillment workflow. The 8-state progression maps directly to a state machine.

findings.title: Basic Auto-Scaling Only
findings.description: App Runner auto-scaling configured (min=1, max=3, MaxConcurrency=100) but uses default settings. No scaling on data layer.
findings.gap: Auto-scaling exists on compute but uses default settings. No scaling on RDS. No custom scaling policies.
findings.recommendation: Tune App Runner MaxConcurrency based on observed patterns. Consider Aurora with auto-scaling for the data tier.

findings.title: Tightly-Coupled Single-File Monolith
findings.description: The application is a tightly-coupled single-file monolith. All 3193 lines — business logic for 7 domains, database schema, API routing, and frontend — are in one file (index.php).
findings.gap: Tightly-coupled monolith with no clear module boundaries and pervasive shared state. All domains share one database with direct cross-table queries.
findings.recommendation: Begin with modular monolith refactoring: extract domain logic into separate files with explicit interfaces. Then apply Strangler Fig.

findings.title: PHP with Limited Cloud-Native Tooling
findings.description: Application written in PHP 8.2 with no framework, no dependency management (no Composer), and no modern patterns. PHP has functional AWS SDK but limited cloud-native tooling ecosystem.
findings.gap: PHP is functional but has limited cloud-native tooling depth. No framework, no dependency management, no modern PHP patterns.
findings.recommendation: For decomposition, consider migrating services to Python/Node.js/Go. If staying with PHP, adopt Laravel/Symfony and Composer.

findings.title: All Communication Synchronous
findings.description: All communication is synchronous within the monolith. Domain interactions are direct function calls and shared database transactions with no async patterns.
findings.gap: All communication synchronous with no async patterns. For a stateful-crud service with 7 tightly-coupled domains, this represents significant architectural risk.
findings.recommendation: Introduce async patterns for cross-domain state propagation as decomposition progresses.

findings.title: No Async Long-Running Process Handling
findings.description: Return processing (24-48 hour manual review) and multi-step fulfillment are handled synchronously. No async job queue or timeout handling.
findings.gap: All operations synchronous regardless of duration. Return processing and order validation require manual intervention with no async infrastructure.
findings.recommendation: Implement async job processing for returns and order validation using SQS + Lambda or Step Functions.

findings.title: No API Versioning
findings.description: No API versioning strategy. All endpoints use unversioned paths (/api/orders, /api/products). No version prefix, headers, or changelog.
findings.gap: No versioning — breaking changes deployed directly with no backward compatibility mechanism.
findings.recommendation: Implement URL-path versioning (e.g., /api/v1/orders). Document versioning strategy before adding external consumers.

findings.title: Environment Variable Endpoints Only
findings.description: Application uses environment variables for database endpoint (DB_HOST). No dynamic service discovery. Adequate for single-service but will not scale for microservices.
findings.gap: Environment variables for endpoints but no dynamic discovery. Will not scale for multi-service architecture.
findings.recommendation: Adopt AWS Cloud Map or App Runner service-to-service communication as services are extracted.

findings.title: No Object Storage for Unstructured Data
findings.description: No S3 or object storage configured. Product images reference placeholder URLs with no actual storage backend.
findings.gap: No object storage for unstructured data. No S3 buckets defined. Product images have no storage infrastructure.
findings.recommendation: Add S3 bucket for product images and document storage. Configure CloudFront CDN for delivery.

findings.title: Scattered Data Access — No Repository Pattern
findings.description: Database queries scattered throughout 3193-line index.php. Raw PDO queries executed inline across all 25+ route handlers with no data access abstraction.
findings.gap: Database imports and queries scattered across the entire codebase with no pattern. No separation between data access and business logic.
findings.recommendation: Extract data access into repository classes per domain as part of modular monolith refactoring.

findings.title: Session-Based Auth — No Token Auth
findings.description: Session-based authentication using PHP sessions and bcrypt hashing. No OAuth2/JWT. WAFv2 IP whitelisting provides network-level access control.
findings.gap: Session-based auth (not token-based). Problematic for horizontal scaling and does not provide per-request token validation.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to JWT via Amazon Cognito. This enables stateless scaling and is a prerequisite for microservices decomposition.

findings.title: No Centralized Identity Provider
findings.description: Application manages its own authentication entirely. Users table stores bcrypt credentials. No external IdP integration.
findings.gap: Application manages its own authentication with no external IdP integration. No federation capabilities.
findings.recommendation: Integrate with Amazon Cognito for centralized identity management, SSO, and MFA.

findings.title: Hardcoded Credential in Source Code
findings.description: Hardcoded fallback credential in source: $pass = getenv('DB_PASS') ?: 'ecommerce_pass' (index.php line 18). Production uses CloudFormation NoEcho parameters but the fallback is in version control.
findings.gap: Plaintext credential present in source code. No Secrets Manager or Vault integration. No rotation configured.
findings.recommendation: Remove hardcoded fallback immediately. Implement AWS Secrets Manager with automated rotation. Update App Runner to retrieve secrets at runtime.

findings.title: Default Base Image — No Hardening
findings.description: Container runs non-root with no-new-privileges and read-only FS. ECR scan-on-push enabled. But default php:8.2-apache base image used with no hardening.
findings.gap: Default base image with no hardening. No SSM Patch Manager, no Inspector integration, no CI/CD gating on scan results.
findings.recommendation: Use hardened base image. Integrate ECR scan results into CI/CD pipeline with blocking gates.

findings.title: No Security Scanning Pipeline
findings.description: No SAST, dependency scanning, or pipeline security validation. No CI/CD pipeline exists to integrate scanning into.
findings.gap: No security scanning tools configured. Pipeline doesn't exist. ECR scan-on-push is the only scanning but not gated.
findings.recommendation: Add SAST (Semgrep), dependency scanning, and container scanning with blocking gates as part of CI/CD implementation.

findings.title: No Distributed Tracing
findings.description: No distributed tracing instrumented. No OpenTelemetry, X-Ray, or trace ID propagation.
findings.gap: No distributed tracing — no visibility into request flows across fulfillment workflow steps.
findings.recommendation: Enable X-Ray tracing on App Runner and add X-Ray SDK to the application.

findings.title: No SLO Definitions
findings.description: No SLO definitions found. No CloudWatch alarms on latency or error rates. Only RDS Enhanced Monitoring and VPC Flow Logs exist.
findings.gap: No SLOs — no formal definition of acceptable service levels.
findings.recommendation: Define SLOs: order creation p99 < 2s, API availability 99.9%, payment success > 99.5%. Implement CloudWatch alarms.

findings.title: No Business Metrics
findings.description: No custom metrics published. Only default infrastructure metrics from App Runner and RDS Enhanced Monitoring.
findings.gap: No custom metrics — no tracking of orders per hour, payment success rate, fulfillment time, or any business outcomes.
findings.recommendation: Publish custom CloudWatch metrics for key business events: orders_created, payments_processed, returns_submitted.

findings.title: No Alerting Configured
findings.description: No CloudWatch alarms defined. No anomaly detection, no static threshold alarms, no PagerDuty/OpsGenie integration.
findings.gap: No alerting — failures would go undetected until user complaints.
findings.recommendation: Add CloudWatch alarms for App Runner 5xx rate, RDS CPU/connections, WAF blocked requests. Enable anomaly detection.

findings.title: Rolling Deployments Only — No Traffic Shifting
findings.description: App Runner provides rolling deployments with health checks but no canary, blue/green, or traffic shifting configured.
findings.gap: Rolling deployments with basic health checks but no staged rollout. Bad deployment affects all traffic once health checks pass.
findings.recommendation: Leverage App Runner deployment features with manual approval gates. Consider ECS with CodeDeploy for canary/blue-green.

findings.title: No Automated Tests
findings.description: No automated tests of any kind exist. No unit tests, integration tests, contract tests, or end-to-end tests.
findings.gap: No automated tests — no safety net for code changes, deployments, or refactoring.
findings.recommendation: Implement PHPUnit tests for critical workflows (order creation, payment processing, return handling). Use test containers.

findings.title: No Incident Response Automation
findings.description: No runbooks, no automated incident response, no self-healing patterns, no SSM Automation documents.
findings.gap: No runbooks — incident response is entirely ad hoc.
findings.recommendation: Create runbooks for common failures: RDS failover, App Runner scaling, high error rates. Implement SSM Automation.

findings.title: No Observability Ownership
findings.description: No CODEOWNERS, no per-service dashboards, no alarms with named owners, no team attribution.
findings.gap: No observability ownership — monitoring is reactive and fragmented.
findings.recommendation: Create CloudWatch dashboard. Define alarm owners and escalation paths. Add CODEOWNERS file.

evaluations.title: Managed Compute
evaluations.reason: Score 3 — App Runner managed compute with auto-scaling; no raw EC2

evaluations.title: Managed Databases
evaluations.reason: Score 3 — RDS MySQL managed with Multi-AZ, encryption, automated backups

evaluations.title: Network Security
evaluations.reason: Score 3 — Custom VPC with private subnets, least-privilege SGs, VPC Flow Logs, WAFv2

evaluations.title: API Entry Point
evaluations.reason: Score 3 — App Runner with WAFv2, health checks, HTTPS termination

evaluations.title: Backup and Recovery
evaluations.reason: Score 3 — RDS 7-day backup retention with DeletionPolicy=Snapshot

evaluations.title: High Availability and Fault Isolation
evaluations.reason: Score 4 — RDS Multi-AZ, subnets span 2 AZs, App Runner multi-instance

evaluations.title: Database Engine Version and EOL
evaluations.reason: Score 4 — MySQL 8.4.8 explicitly pinned, AutoMinorVersionUpgrade enabled, no EOL concerns

evaluations.title: Stored Procedures and Schema Complexity
evaluations.reason: Score 4 — No stored procedures or proprietary SQL; all logic in application layer

evaluations.title: Audit Logging
evaluations.reason: Application-level IaC repo only — CloudTrail is account-level concern

evaluations.title: Encryption at Rest
evaluations.reason: Score 4 — KMS encryption on RDS, ECR, VPC Flow Logs with customer-managed keys and rotation

evaluations.title: Resource Tagging Governance
evaluations.reason: Score 3 — Most resources tagged with Name; some have Environment; inconsistent keys, no enforcement

pathways.name: Move to Cloud Native
pathways.key_trigger_criteria: APP-Q2=1 (primary, monolith) AND INF-Q1=3, APP-Q3=1, APP-Q4=1 (supporting)

triggering_questions.note: Tightly-coupled single-file monolith — primary trigger met
All communication synchronous — supporting trigger met
Long-running operations synchronous — supporting trigger met

immediate_actions: Establish module boundaries in the monolith
Create integration tests for critical workflows
Identify first service extraction candidate (Returns or Fulfillment)

pathways.name: Move to Containers
pathways.key_trigger_criteria: INF-Q1=3 (threshold met but guard prevents); container definitions exist (Dockerfile) and compute is App Runner (managed)

triggering_questions.note: Compute already on managed App Runner; Dockerfile exists — contextual guard prevents trigger

pathways.not_triggered_reason: Compute is already on App Runner (managed container service) and Dockerfile exists. Contextual guard: SHALL NOT trigger when compute is already managed.

pathways.name: Move to Open Source
pathways.key_trigger_criteria: DATA-Q4=4 (no stored procedures); MySQL is already open source — no commercial DB engines detected

triggering_questions.note: No stored procedures — primary trigger not met (score >= 3)

pathways.not_triggered_reason: DATA-Q4=4 (no stored procedures) and no commercial database engines detected. MySQL is open-source.

pathways.name: Move to Managed Databases
pathways.key_trigger_criteria: INF-Q2=3 (database already managed on RDS) — primary trigger not met

triggering_questions.note: Database is already RDS managed — primary trigger requires < 3

pathways.not_triggered_reason: Database is already fully managed (RDS MySQL with Multi-AZ). INF-Q2=3 does not meet threshold.

pathways.name: Move to Managed Analytics
pathways.key_trigger_criteria: No data processing workloads exist — contextual guard prevents trigger
pathways.not_triggered_reason: No streaming, ETL, data pipeline, or analytics artifacts found during discovery. Application has no data processing responsibilities.

pathways.name: Move to Modern DevOps
pathways.key_trigger_criteria: INF-Q10=2 AND INF-Q11=1 (both primary triggers met); OPS-Q5=2, OPS-Q6=1 (supporting)

triggering_questions.note: Partial IaC coverage ~60-70% — primary trigger met
No CI/CD pipeline exists — primary trigger met
Rolling deployments only — supporting trigger met
No automated tests — supporting trigger met

immediate_actions: Create CI/CD pipeline for Docker build and push to ECR

pathways.name: Move to AI
pathways.key_trigger_criteria: No AI/agent intent detected in portfolio or service context
pathways.not_triggered_reason: No AI/agent intent detected in portfolio or service context. Contextual guard requires explicit AI/agent/LLM signal terms in context field.

decomposition_strategy.recommended_approach: Strengthen as Modular Monolith first, then Strangler Fig for high-value service extraction
